title: Comparison counit compatibility with etale restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a commutative ring, V → X an etale object, and F a pro-etale sheaf of Λ-modules. For the canonical comparison adjunction [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], if its counit on the restriction of F to V is an isomorphism, then the restriction to V of its counit on F is an isomorphism. Restriction here is the source localizationRestriction functor, equivalently scheme inverse image along V → X [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image].

proof.text: Build the identity-on-sections isomorphism between comparison lower star followed by etale restriction and pro-etale restriction followed by comparison lower star.

Take its mate under the restriction/lower-star adjunctions. On sections, calculate the mate and identify it with the proved lowerStarCompComparisonLowerStarIso; this reduces to the pullback projection identities.

Use iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm to identify the inverse mate under the comparison adjunctions with a conjugate of an isomorphism. It is therefore invertible. The equation mateEquiv_counit_symm relates the local and restricted global counits. Cancel the invertible mate to obtain the result.

theorem comparison_counit_restriction_isIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (V : X.Etale)
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (h : IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.left).counit.app
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localizationRestriction
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.hom inferInstance).obj F))) :
    IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.localizationRestriction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.hom inferInstance).map
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).counit.app F))
